FN-IMMT6WZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 324
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/01/2024
House Bill 324 as introduced would extend the current quarterly assessment on emergency
medical transport (EMT) providers that will expire on July 1, 2024 to July 1, 2025. In fiscal year
2023, after deducting the costs of collection, the EMT providers' assessment generated $6.1
million for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $8.2
million will be collected in fiscal year 2024 from these assessments.

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds

assessment on emergency medical transport (EMT) providers that will expire on July 1, 2024 to
July 1, 2025. In fiscal year 2023, after deducting the costs of collection, the EMT providers'
assessment generated $6.1 million for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid
Agency estimates $8.2 million will be collected in fiscal year 2024 from these assessments.
